clips.title: The story
paras: Marshal Douglas McBride is the commander of the Stormwind garrison stationed at Northshire Abbey. Tasked with the defense of Northshire Valley, he directs freshly arrived recruits against the rising kobold infestation threatening local farms and mines. He serves as the primary military authority for newcomers beginning their service to the kingdom of Stormwind.

Stationed right outside Northshire Abbey, Marshal Douglas McBride represents the direct authority of the Stormwind Army in this quiet valley. While the abbey itself is an enclave of faith and learning, rising turmoil across the kingdom has stretched military garrisons thin. McBride must maintain peace and secure the valley's food and resource supplies with only a handful of sworn guards and an influx of green recruits seeking training under the abbey's masters.
